summary: Withholding tax treaty rate mismatch blocking payment to NL contractor (manual review hold)
description:
Issue summary: A scheduled outbound payment to a Netherlands-based independent contractor was put on manual hold by our payments pipeline because the withholding tax code applied by AP (WHT-15) does not match the treaty rate flagged by tax-compliance rules (expected WHT-10). Impact: EUR 18,400 payment to vendor VND-003219 is not issued; the vendor has reached out asking for ETA. This also blocks month-end reconciliation for the contractor expense bucket.

Environment: Production payments run (SEPA) processed via payment-run PR-2026-03-10; vendor configured as NL entity with 'reduced treaty' flag in vendor master.

Steps to reproduce / observed behavior:
1) Create invoice INV-987654 for vendor VND-003219 (gross EUR 20,000).
2) AP applied withholding tax code WHT-15 during invoice validation (legacy mapping).
3) Nightly payment-run attempted to create SEPA instruction; tax-compliance policy compared vendor profile and treaty table and expected WHT-10.
4) Payment engine flagged mismatch and routed payment to manual-review queue (status: payment_hold).

Logs / attachments: Payment engine event: pay.2026-03-10.00123.log (attached), vendor profile snapshot (attached), invoice PDF (attached). Error path: payment-bridge rejected with code TX-409-WHT-MISMATCH.

Business context: Vendor is a repeat contractor for ML infra work; delayed payment affects active onboarding and may require advance credit if unresolved. Finance SLA: P1 for cross-border payments > EUR10k.

Requested outcome: Resolve mapping mismatch, release payment, and implement guardrail so legacy mappings do not override treaty lookups going forward.
steps_taken: Checked vendor master and confirmed vendor has 'treaty_reduced_rate' flag set. Reviewed AP invoice history: previous invoice in Jan used WHT-10 and succeeded. Mapping change found in supplier-import job run 2026-02-28; mapping file supplier_wht_map.csv shows VND- prefix mapped to WHT-15 (likely bulk import mistake). Queried payment-bridge logs and confirmed TX-409-WHT-MISMATCH triggered manual hold. Opened temporary override in payment-bridge to allow release after approval.
payment_details: Invoice: INV-987654 | Vendor: VND-003219 | Payment run: PR-2026-03-10 | Amount gross: EUR 20,000 | Withhold applied: WHT-15 | Expected treaty: WHT-10 | Payment id (queued): PAY-20260310-321
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: Supplier import on 2026-02-28 inadvertently added a catch-all mapping mapping VND- prefixes to WHT-15 which overrides vendor-level treaty flag. Confirmed with git diff of supplier-import repo (see related_github_prs). Finance confirmed no manual override was applied previously. Tax team notes: treaty documentation intact; expected reduced rate applies.

Next steps: 1) Roll back supplier_wht_map.csv change for VND- prefix. 2) Re-run invoice tax re-evaluation job for affected invoices and requeue payment. 3) Add automated check during supplier-import to prefer vendor-level treaty flag over prefix mapping. 4) Notify vendor and provide provisional ETA.

Anika Patel (Tax Compliance) 2026-03-11: Treaty rate document for NL vendor class indicates WHT-10. Supplier-import change on 2026-02-28 looks suspect — will coordinate with Platform to revert the mapping. Also, recommend adding unit test against treaty table during imports.

Liam O'Connor 2026-03-12: Reverted supplier_wht_map.csv in repo (github.com/redwood/supplier-import commit b7f4d9a) and queued tax-reval job (job id: TAX-REV-20260312-77). Will monitor requeue to payments queue and update vendor via templated email.
Maya Chen 2026-03-12: Finance approved manual release contingency if requeue fails. Please update ticket when payment leaves queue.
resolution_notes: (pending) Reverted bad mapping and queued tax re-eval. If TAX-REV job produces WHT-10, payment will be auto-requeued; otherwise payments team will perform approved manual release. Follow-up action: add import validation and a sentinel alert when prefix-level mappings change.
